notes: MCGM policy grants a 5%–10% property tax rebate (standard 8%) for residential societies adopting waste composting, greywater recycling, and rooftop terrace greening.
GHMC encourages urban cooling and cool roof / green roof mandates with 7% property tax incentives and expedited building plan approvals for IGBC Green homes.
PMC provides one of the highest rebates in India: up to 10% on general tax for properties with functional solar water heating and registered rooftop terrace gardens.
Delhi Master Plan 2041 prioritizes rooftop urban farming and extensive greening to combat PM2.5 winter smog and extreme urban heat island temperatures.
GCC incentivizes coastal urban stormwater resilience and rooftop green patches to reduce runoff into the Adyar and Cooum river basins.
